sql: SELECT e.event_id, e.product_category, COUNT(r.recall_number) AS recall_count FROM events e LEFT JOIN recalls r ON r.event_id = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.product_category ORDER BY e.event_id

SELECT state, firm_name FROM (SELECT f.state, f.firm_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, f.firm_name, f.firm_id) AS rn FROM recalls r JOIN firms f ON f.firm_id = r.firm_id GROUP BY f.state, f.firm_id, f.firm_name) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY state

SELECT recall_number, classification, interval_days FROM (SELECT recall_number, classification, julianday(center_classification_date) - julianday(recall_initiation_date) AS interval_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY classification ORDER BY julianday(center_classification_date) - julianday(recall_initiation_date) DESC, recall_number ASC) AS rn FROM recalls) WHERE rn = 1

SELECT product_category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN classification IN ('Class I','Class II') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM recalls GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY pct DESC, product_category ASC
SELECT meaning FROM classifications WHERE classification = 'Class I'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_type = 'Drugs'
SELECT distribution_pattern FROM recalls WHERE recall_number = 'D-0697-2026'

SELECT f.state, COUNT(DISTINCT f.firm_id) AS firm_count, COUNT(r.recall_number) AS recall_count FROM firms f LEFT JOIN recalls r ON r.firm_id = f.firm_id WHERE f.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.state ORDER BY f.state

SELECT p.product_description, f.firm_name FROM products p JOIN recalls r ON r.recall_number = p.recall_number JOIN firms f ON f.firm_id = r.firm_id WHERE r.recall_initiation_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' ORDER BY r.recall_number ASC, p.product_id ASC
SELECT product_category, COUNT(*) AS recall_count FROM recalls WHERE voluntary_mandated = 'Voluntary: Firm initiated' GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY recall_count DESC, product_category ASC

WITH t AS (SELECT r.recall_number, r.classification, c.severity_rank, julianday(r.report_date) - julianday(r.center_classification_date) AS interval_days FROM recalls r LEFT JOIN classifications c ON c.classification = r.classification) SELECT recall_number, classification, interval_days FROM t WHERE interval_days > (SELECT AVG(t2.interval_days) FROM t t2 WHERE t2.classification = t.classification) ORDER BY severity_rank, interval_days DESC, recall_number ASC

SELECT r.product_category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.classification = 'Class I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct FROM products p JOIN recalls r ON r.recall_number = p.recall_number GROUP BY r.product_category ORDER BY pct DESC, r.product_category ASC
SELECT address_1, city, state FROM firms WHERE firm_name = 'CareFusion 213, LLC'
SELECT product_quantity FROM products WHERE product_id = 2
